entries.note: The posting scan, opened by its UPU event code.

entries.wording: Đi khỏi bưu cục (Departure from PO)
entries.note: Left a post office; the office follows in brackets.

entries.wording: Đã đến bưu cục (Arrival at PO)
entries.note: Arrived at a post office; the office follows in brackets.

entries.wording: Đã vận chuyển đi khỏi bưu cục (Transport departure from PO)
entries.note: The truck left a post office; the office follows in brackets.

entries.wording: Đã vận chuyển đến bưu cục (Transport arrival at PO)
entries.note: The truck reached a post office; the office follows in brackets.

entries.wording: EDG - Đã giao bưu tá phát - Item out for physical delivery

entries.note: Written in the second the delivery office hands the item to the postman; it keeps the stage before it.
Forwarded, here to a new address after a failed attempt.
Delivery-detail line for a failed attempt; a numbered reason follows.
The item's summary status and delivery-detail line.
Cash on delivery collected from the recipient.
Cash on delivery paid to the sender.
